privacy.complaint.body:
If you believe we process your data unlawfully, you may file a proposal to commence proceedings on the protection of personal data under § 100 of Act No. 18/2018 Coll.

Úrad na ochranu osobných údajov Slovenskej republiky, Galvaniho Business Centrum II, Galvaniho 7/B, 821 04 Bratislava, Slovakia, e-mail statny.dozor@pdp.gov.sk, web dataprotection.gov.sk.
privacy.controller.body:
The controller is MK Digital s. r. o., Medená 15387/2, 974 05 Banská Bystrica, Slovakia, company number 55 450 229, registered in the Commercial Register of the District Court Banská Bystrica, section Sro, insert 47559/S, e-mail admin@mkdigital.sk.

We have not designated a data protection officer — our processing does not require one.
privacy.controller.h: 1. Who we are and how to reach us
privacy.data.body:
When you create an account we process your e-mail address and your password. We do not store the password — only a cryptographic hash of it, from which the original cannot be recovered.

We also store your theme and language preference, and the times the account was created and last changed. We do not collect your name.
privacy.obligation.body:
The e-mail and password are a contractual requirement — without them we cannot create the account. We ask for nothing else.

We do not verify the address and send no marketing to it.
privacy.obligation.h: 4. Do you have to provide this?
privacy.purpose.body:
We process the e-mail and the password hash to create and run your account — to register you, sign you in, and show you your own data. Without them the service cannot exist. Legal basis: Article 6(1)(b) GDPR (performance of a contract).

Theme and language preferences are processed on the same basis, as part of the service. Timestamps are processed on our legitimate interest in keeping an administrative and security record of the account, Article 6(1)(f) GDPR. You may object to that processing.

We do not use the data for marketing and never sell it.
privacy.recipients.body:
These processors handle the data on our behalf: Railway Corporation (USA) — application server; Neon (Databricks, Inc., USA) — the database the account is stored in; Vercel Inc. (USA) — hosting for this web application.

The mobile showcase apps (Android, iOS, React Native) additionally use Google (Firebase) for notification delivery and crash reporting. This web application uses none of those.

We do not give or sell the data to anyone else.
privacy.retention.body:
We keep the data while you have an account. When you delete the account, we delete it.

These are demonstration applications, so we also remove inactive accounts without waiting for you to ask: if nobody opens an account for 30 days, we delete it and the notes in it. Backups are overwritten on the ordinary backup cycle.
privacy.rights.body:
Under the GDPR you have the right of access (Art 15), rectification (Art 16), erasure (Art 17), restriction of processing (Art 18) and data portability (Art 20). You may object under Art 21 to the processing we base on legitimate interest (the timestamps).

You can delete your account in the app itself. For the other rights, write to admin@mkdigital.sk.
privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.transfers.body:
Those processors are US-based companies, so a transfer to a third country takes place. Choosing a European storage region does not change this — what governs is where the provider is established, not where the server sits.

The transfer relies on the European Commission adequacy decision for the EU–US Data Privacy Framework (Implementing Decision (EU) 2023/1795) where the provider is certified under it, and alongside that on the Commission Standard Contractual Clauses (Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/914). We will provide a copy of the safeguards used on request at admin@mkdigital.sk.

terms.account.body: The account is yours and is used by one person only. Enter your own e-mail address — we do not verify it and send nothing to it, but it is how we recognise you when you sign in. Give your password to nobody; if you learn that someone else knows it, change it or tell us.
terms.changes.body: We may change the terms when the apps or the law change. We tell you about a significant change by e-mail or in the app at least 30 days before it takes effect; if you disagree with it, delete your account before that day and the contract ends without any payment. The current wording is always on this page.
terms.contract.body:
You conclude the contract to use the apps by creating an account: you enter an e-mail address and a password and press the Sign Up button. These terms are our offer; by creating the account you accept it, and the contract is concluded the moment the app creates your account and signs you in — which is also how it confirms that the account was created.

Before pressing the button you can correct the e-mail address and the password in the form itself; the app warns you about an invalid address or a weak password and creates no account. We do not store the contract as a document: its content is these terms, whose current wording is always on this page, where you can view, save or print them at any time. The contract is concluded in Slovak; if you use the app in another language, you see a translation and the Slovak wording governs.
terms.data.body: We process your e-mail address and the hash of your password to create and run your account — to perform this contract. What else we process and why, whom we pass data to and what rights you have is set out in the Privacy notice, which you find when creating the account and in the footer of the web.
terms.disputes.body:
If you create the account as a natural person outside your business or profession, you are a consumer and the contract is a consumer contract: these terms cannot depart from the law to your detriment, and in doubt the reading more favourable to you applies.

The contract is governed by the law of the Slovak Republic. If you habitually reside in another country, this choice does not deprive you of the protection of those provisions of that country’s law which cannot be derogated from by agreement.

If you are unhappy with something, write to us at the address in section 1.1; we reply within 30 days. If we refuse or do not reply within 30 days, you may submit a proposal for alternative dispute resolution to the Slovak Trade Inspection (Slovenská obchodná inšpekcia) — how to do so is explained at soi.sk/alternativne-riesenie-spotrebitelskych-sporov. You may also turn to a court.
terms.duration.body:
The contract lasts as long as you have the account. You can delete the account at any time in the app itself; that ends the contract, and we remove your data and notes as the Privacy notice describes.

An account nobody opens for 30 days is deleted together with the notes in it, without any request from you. We may also end the showcase or cancel your account otherwise; we tell you in the app or by e-mail at least 30 days in advance. Without that notice we cancel an account only if you have breached section 5.1.
terms.notes.body:
You store your own notes in the apps, for yourself. They must contain nothing that is against the law or infringes the rights of others. We show the notes to nobody, do not read them and run no automated checks on them; we step in only on a notice under section 5.2 — such content is removed and the account may be cancelled.

Anyone may notify us by e-mail to the address in section 1.1 that the apps hold illegal content: say where the content is and why it is illegal, and give your name and e-mail address. We confirm receipt of the notice and tell you without undue delay how we decided and how you can contest the decision.
terms.provider.body:
The MK Digital showcase apps — the web app at showcase.mkdigital.sk and the mobile apps for Android and iOS (the “apps”) — are provided by MK Digital s. r. o., Medená 15387/2, 974 05 Banská Bystrica, Slovakia, company number 55 450 229, registered in the Commercial Register of the District Court Banská Bystrica, section Sro, insert 47559/S (“we”). Write to us at admin@mkdigital.sk or call +421 951 892 670.

As a provider we are supervised by the Slovak Trade Inspection — Slovenská obchodná inšpekcia, Inšpektorát SOI pre Banskobystrický kraj, Dolná 46, 974 00 Banská Bystrica.
terms.service.body:
The apps are a showcase of the templates we build client apps from. Once you create an account you can try signing in, notes stored on our server, and demonstrations of device and browser features. You use them free of charge — you pay nothing and commit to nothing beyond these terms.

The apps are a demonstration, not a place to keep what you need. We may change, suspend or end them at any time, and an account nobody opens for 30 days is deleted together with the notes in it (section 6.2). Do not store anything in them that you do not also have elsewhere.
